scope: 120 disjoint assigned current paths; static AST/body/provider investigation only. No historical Python execution, migration credit, retirement authorization, production/recipe/ISO/registry changes or emulator/PINE.

verification.test_policy: No production change: verified input hashes, AST parse, source/evidence locations, exact set coverage and report JSON; no broad test/build/emulator run.

method: Read current source bytes for every path, parse every AST node, inspect imports/docstrings/defs/calls, branch/loop/raise/assert guards and named literal tables. Current roles are based on executable bodies, never purpose hints. Resolve _text facade exports through static ImportFrom reexports to actual definitions; inspect each target body. For25 current refusal stubs also parse read-only git bodies, record exact-vs-different historical pins. Dynamic context callbacks and computed references remain explicitly unproved. Parent owns global normalized-function similarity fingerprints; none are treated here as merge proof. Per-script import ASTs were inspected; verbose import spellings omitted to keep report compact. Global similarity candidates are external leads, not safe merges or semantic equivalence.
